title: Addicted to sugar
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why is sugar difficult for many people to reduce even when they want to?
Should companies be required to reduce added sugar in popular products?
Are sugar taxes fair, or do they interfere too much with personal choice?
Which matters more: how much sugar you eat at once or how often you eat it?
What food or drink contains more sugar than people often realise?
